_doc: Single source of truth for BASELINE vs LAYERS scoring (DEEP_REVIEW_2026-06-11 / SESSION-BASELINE-WEIGHTS). Baseline = only components with pre-registered statistical justification; everything else stays computed + persisted but carries zero base weight and is exposed as an optional user-addable layer. Membership changes ONLY per PROMOTION_CRITERIA.md (repo root). ref_weight = the legacy composite weight, used (a) to keep persisted component-point history comparable across the transition and (b) to renormalize user layer views.

ref_weights._doc: Legacy-composite weights for EVERY component (baseline + layers). Used to (a) keep persisted component-point columns comparable across the transition and (b) renormalize client-side layer views: view = sum(raw_k * ref_w_k) / sum(ref_w_k) * 100 over {baseline + selected layers}. Baseline alone reduces to the pure baseline score; all layers selected reproduces the legacy composite (minus the earnings multiplier).

direction_picker.note: The symmetric directional rule (PR #6) picks play direction and labels but carries ZERO baseline score weight: its +0.05-0.06 signed IC is from one 70-day regime and fails the two-sub-period consistency bar. Re-evaluate at the 250d re-run.
